caption: The drawing consists of a plain, off-white or yellowed background with slightly uneven coloration, suggesting aged paper. At the center, there are four characters outlined in thin, hand-drawn black lines: the capital letter "G," a capital letter "Y," and the numbers "1773." The "G" and "Y" are placed at the top, slightly off-center, with the "G" to the left and the "Y" to the right, while "1773" is situated directly beneath the "G" and slightly overlapping its lower curve. The characters are rendered in a simple, serif style, and there are no additional decorative elements, images, or colors present in the composition. The lines of the characters are lightly textured with some cross-hatching, and the overall arrangement is sparse, occupying a small portion of the page's central area.
title: Scouring Box
